caption: The drawing depicts a group of hollyhock flowers with stems and leaves arranged in a cluster. The flowers are in various colors including deep red, pale pink, lavender, soft white, and light purple, with the petals showing gradient shading to suggest depth and texture. The leaves are large and green with brownish and yellowish tinges, also detailed with veins. A light brown bee with white wings appears near the flowers on the right side. All the botanical elements are positioned in front of a black, cushion-like rectangular background that has visible folds and highlights, contrasting with the light beige or cream-colored outer border of the drawing. Vertical gold-colored Japanese characters are written on the right side of the composition, next to the black rectangular shape.
title: Pillow
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
